patch: Liraasa 3.4 — Abstraction and the human condition
status: PROPOSED: ratify tier 1 first; tier 2 may be ratified, deferred or dropped item by item
principles: No new roots: every entry is built from existing headwords.
Existing words are reused through aliases before anything is coined.
Motion prefixes, causatives, li + adjective and 3.3:G148 adjectives are documented as recipes rather than listed.

rulings_add.rule: For a compound X whose adjective is available under 3.3:G148, the bare compound names the quality and X-san describes what has it: tibilekta complexity, tibilektasan complex; lordidoza strictness, lordidozasan strict. A person defined by a quality is li + the adjective (1.2:G29): li corvinasan, the coward. No -ness or -ity suffix is needed or created.
examples: Li lordidozasan lemudonuyo po ne merama li linu.
The strict teacher did not forgive the child.
